args.text: Start a note to June about the PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb, and Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads 'Covey — Late Arrivals'. Post the bullets here.

args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living vs Covey
args.body:
June,

A note on the PHL label confusion (from Sofia Marchetti):

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- The coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals", so the old name is still showing in that report.
- The report label needs updating to Pellow Home Living so people searching for it find the right account.

Sofia Marchetti (Coastal team)

args.text:

I also saved a draft note to June (joseilark@pemberline.com) in your mailbox with the same bullets. Nothing has been sent.

The draft and the channel reply both say the saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals" and needs relabelling to Pellow Home Living. If you want the draft in your own mailbox to send yourself, I can save a new one to smarchetti@pemberline.com.

Finish Sofia's note and save it as a mail draft to June Osei-Lark with the subject 'PHL label cleanup': add that the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
June,

A note on the PHL label confusion, from Sofia Marchetti and Bettina Kroll (Coastal team):

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- The coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals", so the old name is still showing in that report.
- The saved report label needs updating to Pellow Home Living.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows (Pellucid Harbor Logistics).
- The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments (Pellow Home Living).

Sofia Marchetti (Coastal team), with Bettina Kroll
